title: The new app every movie lover needs
author: David Pierce

recommendations.name: Callsheet
recommendations.blurb: ( link ): I hate the IMDb app and the website with the huge banner telling you about the app.

recommendations.name: Strange Planet on Apple TV Plus
recommendations.blurb: ( link ): Nathan Pyle’s comic has been one of the best things on Instagram for years, and I’ve been really enjoying the new animated show as well. It has some Rick and Morty and Bojack Horseman DNA, plus a little bit of Ted Lasso vibes?

recommendations.name: Goodnotes 6.0
recommendations.blurb: ( link ) : Goodnotes is my favorite cross-platform tool for handwritten notes, and it just got some really clever updates — including an AI tool that can learn your handwriting, correct your spelling, and even write longhand for you. Wild.

recommendations.name: Nerf Pro Stryfe X
recommendations.blurb: ( link ): My colleague Sean Hollister called this “the best official blaster ever made,” and trust me, Sean knows his stuff. It’s the first-ever official Nerf blaster to use half-length darts, and it’s modded for outrageous firepower.

recommendations.name: The YouTube Effect
recommendations.blurb: ( link ) : A new doc from Alex Winter about the whole story of YouTube. There’s good, there’s bad, Section 230 appears, and it doesn’t cover a huge amount of new ground, but it’s a really good dive into the nuances of the platform.

recommendations.name: Shortwave for Android
recommendations.blurb: ( link ): Shortwave is one of the few email apps I think is onto something really right . It’s a bit like Google Inbox in that it’s constantly sorting and categorizing your inbox to make it work. The Android app is a little buggy in this first iteration, but it’s still one to try.

recommendations.name: Netflix Game Controller
recommendations.blurb: ( link ) : Netflix has been pushing into gaming for a while now, but this is the most interesting development yet — it’s building a controller app that you use to play games on your TV. It seems super early and maybe wasn’t released intentionally at all, but keep an eye on this one.

recommendations.name: The Lego Concorde
recommendations.blurb: ( link ) : I have two competing thoughts on all these incredibly cool new Lego sets. One is they are absurdly, preposterously expensive — this one is $200 and isn’t even the worst you’ll find. But the second is that I want them all so, so, so bad.

recommendations.name: Arc
recommendations.blurb: First up: Josh Miller, the CEO of The Browser Company, which makes a browser called Arc ( link ) that continues to be one of the most interesting new apps on the market.

recommendations.name: iPhone 14 Pro Max
recommendations.blurb: The phone: iPhone 14 Pro Max

recommendations.name: Twisted Metal
recommendations.blurb: I watched Twisted Metal ( link ) on Hulu by accident and then finished it because it’s purely ridiculous from start to finish. This TikTok ( link ) of someone building a bomber in Tears of the Kingdom with “Fortunate Son” playing and hashtag oil is a PhD thesis waiting to happen.

recommendations.name: SoundHound
recommendations.blurb: I have yet to find a song recognition app for Apple Watch that works better than SoundHound ( link ) . The thing I love the most about SoundHound is a feature I didn’t even know I wanted: live lyrics for the detected song on my watch.

recommendations.name: System76 Launch keyboard
recommendations.blurb: My current obsession gadget is the System76 Launch keyboard ( link ) . Thing is amazing, metal build, made in Colorado, works on every OS... and of course RGB.

recommendations.name: Flighty
recommendations.blurb: For travel, I will recommend: Flighty ( link ) for live status of planes. This app saved us hours of pain in our recent trip to Europe where the budget airlines were changing terminals at the last second without informing us.

recommendations.name: Tripsy
recommendations.blurb: For travel, I will recommend: Flighty ( link ) for live status of planes. This app saved us hours of pain in our recent trip to Europe where the budget airlines were changing terminals at the last second without informing us.

recommendations.name: Beeper
recommendations.blurb: An app called Beeper ( link ) is a fully realized all-in-one messaging app based on Matrix that preserves the open-source nature of the protocol and its surrounding apps. It’s a startup by Eric Migicovsky, founder of Pebble.

recommendations.name: Sink It for Reddit
recommendations.blurb: A recent iOS app I’ve been loving is Sink It for Reddit ( link ) , which greatly improves the Reddit mobile experience through Safari. After the loss of our beloved Apollo, I tried the official Reddit app.

recommendations.name: My80sTV
recommendations.blurb: This week: My80sTV ( link ) , a website that actually lets you watch TV from the ’80s on an ’80s-style TV. In your web browser. Sure. There’s a dedicated site for every decade since the ’50s! It’s great.
